how.title: How It Works
how.step1: Approve $10 USDC — one MetaMask click. The contract can only ever pull exactly $10.
how.step2: Register — you're placed into the T1 Figure-8 matrix at the next available seat.
how.step3: Earn — as new members join, USDC flows up through the chain. Withdraw anytime.
how.step4: Auto-upgrade — once your matrix fills (127 seats), you automatically advance to T2 ($25).

idx.title: CryptoNova — The Matrix
idx.hero_sub: Join the CryptoNova Matrix. Start at T1 ($10 USDC) and auto-upgrade through 10 tiers. Earn referral bonuses, chain pay, and CNOVA tokens — all on Base Chain.
idx.how_s1_b: Click "Connect Wallet" in the top-right. MetaMask and Rabby are both supported. Make sure you're on Base Sepolia testnet.
idx.how_s2_b: On testnet, the MockUSDC contract minted $10,000 to the deployer. Ask for a test transfer, or use the faucet button.
idx.how_s3_b: Allow the Matrix contract to spend $10 USDC on your behalf. One MetaMask confirmation.
idx.how_s4_b: Confirm the register transaction. You'll be placed into the CryptoNova Matrix at the next available seat.
idx.how_s5_b: As new members register, USDC flows through the chain to you. Withdraw any time from the Dashboard.

split.title: Entry Fee Split — per $10 at T1
split.mechanic_body: Fill Matrix A → root crosses to Matrix B → fill B → root auto-upgrades to T2. The loop repeats for each tier.
